functions.name: SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest
functions.summary: Nearest-strut query over a strut array with optional strut-type filtering and a plane-side rejection test. Scans all struts (count at this+0x130, array base this+0x134, stride 316) for the minimum squared distance from a query point a2, requiring a3 == -1 or a3 == the strut type at +300. If a best strut is found, a plane-normal product (+164/+172 coefficients against the strut's +148/+152/+156 position) decides whether to return the strut pointer itself or its linked collision child at +272. Returns 0 immediately when the count is 0.

operations.description: If the strut count at this+0x130 is less than or equal to 0, return 0 immediately (no struts to scan).
Initialize result v4 to 0 and best squared distance v12 to 9.9999999e36.
Load strut array base v5 = this+0x134 and loop counter v6 = count (this+0x130).
Iterate over the struts, advancing the cursor by stride 316 and decrementing the counter until it reaches 0.
Compute squared distance from query point a2 to the current strut's position (+148/+152/+156) as dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz.
Candidate test per strut: accept only if the squared distance is below the current best AND (a3 == -1 OR a3 == the dword type at +300).
When the candidate test passes, record the strut pointer as best (v4) and the distance as best (v12).

Plane test on the best strut: if a best strut exists and the product of normal coefficients at +164/+172 with (strut position at +148/+156 minus query point) is negative, select the linked collision child pointer at +272 instead.
Return the best strut pointer, or the linked child pointer at +272 when the plane test rejects the strut.

functions.name: BVHNearestNeighborQuery
functions.summary: Nearest-neighbor traversal over a linked chain of physics nodes. Computes the squared distance from the query position (this+0/4/8) to the first node, then walks node+272 child links while the cumulative path length (sum of node+60 values) stays below 200.0 (flt_59E470). Descends when a child's squared distance is strictly smaller than the current best; early-outs and returns the current node otherwise, or returns the child immediately when it has no further child. A null start node returns itself unchanged. Called by AISteering (004270A0).

operations.description: Null guard: when a2 (start node) is 0 the function returns a2 immediately without traversing
Seed squared distance v15 from the query position this+0/4/8 against the first node's position fields (node+148/152/156)

Chain traversal: while the current node has a child at node+272, accumulate node+60 into the path length v16, compute the child's squared distance, and descend when it is strictly below the current best v15
Path-length guard: traversal stops when the accumulated path length v16 exceeds 200.0, the threshold held by flt_59E470
Spatial-culling guard: when the child's squared distance is >= the current best v15, traversal stops and the current node is returned
Returns the closest node v4, or the child v10 immediately when that child has no further child at node+272; the function is called by AISteering (004270A0)

functions.name: SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch
functions.summary: Spatial tree nearest-neighbor search over a linked node structure. Given a query point a2 and an identifier a4, descends and walks the node chains (+268 siblings, +272 children) keeping the node with minimum squared distance, with identifier checks (+300). When the tree walk yields no candidate (null node) or the optional plane test (a5) rejects the candidate, it falls back to SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest. Used by AI racing-line / steering callers.

operations.description: If starting node a3 is null, call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return its result.
If a3+300 != a4 and a3+276 is nonzero and (a3+276)+300 == a4, switch the working node to a3+276.
Compute squared distance from query point a2 to the node position stored at +148/+152/+156.
Walk the +268 sibling chain while distance decreases and node+300 == a4, tracking the closest node; if the chain ends, call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return.
Walk the +272 child chain while distance decreases, tracking the closest node; if the chain ends, call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return.
If a5 (plane-test flag) is set and the closest node fails the plane-side test computed from +164/+172 coefficients and its +148/+156 position, advance to the +272 child.
Return the closest node, or call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return its result if no node was selected.

functions.name: EulerToRotationMatrix
functions.summary: Converts three Euler angles in a1[0..2] into a 3x3 rotation matrix written row-major into a2[0..8]. Pure trigonometric computation with no side effects and no callees.

Compute v4 = sin(a1[1]) and v7 = cos(a1[1]).
Compute v5 = sin(a1[2]) and v6 = cos(a1[2]).
Compute intermediate products v9 = v6 * v7 and v8 = v5 * v7.
Write row 0 column 0 of the output matrix: a2[0] = v4 * v2 * v5 + v9.
Write row 0 column 1: a2[1] = v4 * v2 * v6 - v8.
Write row 0 column 2: a2[2] = v4 * v3.
Write row 1 column 0: a2[3] = v5 * v3.
Write row 1 column 1: a2[4] = v6 * v3.
Write row 1 column 2: a2[5] = -v2.
Write row 2 column 0: a2[6] = v8 * v2 - v6 * v4.
Write row 2 column 1: a2[7] = v5 * v4 + v9 * v2.
Write row 2 column 2: a2[8] = v7 * v3.
